# Colour

One blue and a set of pure greys. Whity Blue is the platform; every grey has zero chroma, so a tenant's own colour never fights a tint it did not choose.

![The palette: brand blues, greys, status colours, chart series and a derived tenant colour](data:image/png;base64,)

## Status

Each status is three tokens: a **fill** (with its own label colour), a **text** colour that reads on cards and on the page, and a **tint** for badges and alert grounds. Error and destructive are one colour. Info is neutral grey: blue is kept for action and the brand.

| Status | Fill · label | Text | Tint | Dark: fill · tint |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Success | `#0a7e3a` · white | `#087736` | `#e0fae4` | `#5ac576` · `#14361d` |
| Warning | `#f2b036` · `#1a1206` | `#9a5505` | `#fef4df` | `#f7b83d` · `#432f07` |
| Error | `#cc2827` · white | `#c2181d` | `#fceeec` | `#f66d67` · `#4f1a18` |
| Info | `#555555` · white | `#555555` | `#f0f0f0` | `#aeaeae` · `#262626` |

Status colours mean status only, always with a word or an icon, never as brand colours and never in marketing.

## Charts

| | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Light | main `#0961bb` | amber `#f7a224` | sky `#91dbf2` | plum `#9d2398` | green `#35aa76` | graphite `#3a3a3a` |
| Dark | main `#59a0f9` | `#f7a224` | `#91dbf2` | `#d25bcb` | `#53c48e` | `#858585` |

- Series 1 is always the tenant's main colour. Neighbouring series differ by at least 0.08 in OKLab under deuteranopia and protanopia, checked in both modes (the dark graphite moved to `#858585` in 2.1 to pass beside green). Graphite is also the "Other" slice.
- Every chart has a legend for two or more series, labels one value, and offers "Show as table", so nothing depends on colour alone (section 17).
- Ordered data (sequential) uses lightness steps of the main colour, not the categorical set.
- On paper, charts are grey with the one bar that matters in ink (section 16).

## Tenant colour

One colour goes in; the rest is derived from its hue (decision 2.8): on dark at lightness 0.70 (chroma up to 0.15), the plane at 0.30 (up to 0.10), the tint at 0.96 (up to 0.03). Each can be overridden. The label on the colour is white or near-black, whichever passes 4.5:1; if neither does, the colour is darkened and the admin sees what changed. The demo tenant, Example Bakery, is burnt orange `#b74c05` (white label 5.2:1) with `#e97c47` on dark, `#4f1c00` plane and `#feeee7` tint.

## Contrast (WCAG 2.2)

| Pair | Light | Dark |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ink on page | 17.1 | 19.0 |
| Ink on card | 19.8 | 17.2 |
| Main colour on card (links) | 6.1 | 6.7 |
| Label on main colour | 6.1 | 6.7 |
| Secondary text on card · on page | 5.5 · 4.7 | 6.9 · 7.7 |
| Control border on card (non-text, 3:1) | 3.1 | 3.3 |
| Selected tint text on tint | 5.5 | 6.8 |
| Status text on card · on page · on its tint | 5.7–7.5 · 4.9–6.4 · 5.1–6.5 | 6.2–10.1 on card |
| Warning label on warning fill | 9.7 | |

Every text pair passes 4.5:1 in both themes; every control border and focus ring passes 3:1.

## Print

Match Whity Blue from a physical proof with your printer; screen values do not convert reliably to CMYK. For one colour, use the `ink` logo files. Documents keep the tenant colour on the title only (section 16).
